hooks.name: Test engine on save
hooks.description: Run engine unit + property tests whenever the agent edits deterministic engine packages.

hooks.name: Verify after spec task
hooks.description: After each spec task: vet, full tests, and a golden replay so determinism never silently breaks.

action.command: go vet ./... && go test ./... && go run ./cmd/wraith replay --golden testdata/

hooks.name: Engine purity reminder
hooks.description: Before writing into engine packages, remind the agent of the dependency and determinism rules.

action.prompt: If this write touches internal/arena, internal/manor, internal/ledger or internal/gm: do not import llm, web or crew; do not read wall-clock time; do not iterate maps where order affects output. Illegal agent input must become a Rejected ledger event, never a panic.
